messages:
sarah.ng: Heads up — red team found a way to start an import-session to our staging HSM without the operator witness step. Can we triage? cc @ravi.oncall
redteam-bot: Repro steps (short): 1) POST /hsm/import-session with X-Request-Id=rt-... 2) replay sig from previous session 3) receive 200 + session_id.
redteam-bot: Minimal repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-kms.redwood.internal/hsm/import-session
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <session-token>"
  -H "X-Replay: true"
  -d '{"wrapped_key": "...", "attestation": "sig-v1"}'
```
redteam-bot: We saw missing enforcement in the operator-witness middleware (middleware returns 204 not 401) when replay header is set.
mike.infra: Ack. I'm on it. Is this limited to staging HSM sidecar? or also affects proxy?
redteam-bot: Confirmed staging sidecar and standalone local proxy. Prod KMS appears ok but not yet fully verified.
julia.runtime: If they're replaying a previous attestation, we need stronger nonce binding + per-session attestation validation. Also check our KV for session nonces — might be racey.
ravi.oncall: I can rotate the staging operator keys and revoke active import-sessions. Quick mitigation: revoke operator-token and enable strict replay detection on sidecar. Want to coordinate now?
lin.sec: +1, and we should produce compliance evidence for the SOC2 team: timeline, reproducer, mitigation steps, and audit log extracts. Don't delete logs.
mike.infra: I'll push a hotfix to sidecar: require attestation.sig_version == v2 and nonce check. Patch will be behind a feature flag and rolled to staging only for now. Will add extra audit log fields: request.replay_detected = true/false and operator_witness_id.
deploy-bot: deploy request created by mike.infra for branch fix/byo-replay-detect -> staging (PR #4821). CI checks pending.
sarah.ng: Good. For RBAC: we should temporarily add a tight rule that only 'operator-escrow' group can call /hsm/import-session for staging. Can someone update the RBAC policy?
mike.infra: I'll add a short-lived policy change and annotate in the commit message. Policy name: rbac/hsm-import-session-staging-2026-03-21.
julia.runtime: Also add an alert in Console: if import-session success && operator_witness_id == null then page SRE and notify security channel.
lin.sec: I'll draft the incident memo for compliance: what happened, scope (staging/proxy), proof-of-concept, fixes, timeline, and evidence IDs. Please send me the audit log slices as S3 URIs.
ravi.oncall: Done: revoked tokens, feature-flag enabled, rolling restart of sidecar in staging started. Postmortem meeting 30m.
redteam-bot: Verified mitigation: replay returns 401 now for our repro. Nice.
sarah.ng: Great. After postmortem, we need to backport to prod if any component shares code path. Also re-run red team on canary.
lin.sec: Filing ticket for compliance evidence retention: ensure logs retained for 90 days and exported to secure bucket with WORM. Ticket created: SEC-1543.
mike.infra: PR merged to staging, will schedule prod rollout after security review.
julia.runtime: Followups: (1) formalize per-session nonce binding in spec, (2) add unit tests for replay detection, (3) update KMS integration docs to require signed attestation v2.
sarah.ng: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open for evidence URIs and PM notes.
redteam-bot: Leaving a note: we used a timed nonce replay to bypass >20s TTL. Consider shortening TTL or binding to operator nonce + session id.
